title: Add and Multiply Queries
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 10^5; 1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9; 1 \leq B_i \leq 10^9; 1 \leq Q \leq 10^5; For type 1 and 2 queries, 1 \leq i \leq N.; For type 1 and 2 queries, 1 \leq x \leq 10^9.; For type 3 queries, 1 \leq l \leq r \leq N.; For type 3 queries, the value to be printed is at most 10^{18}.
